propositions: Review gates cannot distinguish clean execution from failed, cancelled, skipped, budget-shed, or resumed outcomes, causing plan-review failures to become empty successful checkpoints and code-review losses of earlier work when later criteria raise.

The discovery kernel must define immutable input plans (DiscoveryStagePlan/DiscoveryUnitPlan) and typed per-unit outcomes (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled) with dependency-aware scheduling, deterministic shedding order, and dependency-reason skips.
A versioned digest-complete checkpoint/trace envelope must round-trip only content-identical success/resumed records; failed, cancelled, skipped, and shed units remain missing and cannot be reused.

Budget shedding must be deterministic (ascending dependency rank then stable unit id), preserve independent results after exhausted local operation, and treat cap_override=None as computed, 0.0 as valid reject, and never shed containers.

Cancellation must preserve already-dispatched non-interruptible calls as their true outcome with real usage, mark not-yet-dispatched units as cancelled, and abort remaining work with exact accounting.

The stored trace contains normalized ids, outcomes, reason codes, usage, and lineage only—excluding raw prompts, context bodies, provider responses, and secrets—while maintaining unchanged public review result schemas.
